whose relative clauses · 要点精讲(第4轮): whose introduces a relative clause expressing belonging to the antecedent, followed by a noun.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:whose expresses belonging, modifying people or things。
whose + noun = the person/thing's|whose can guide both people and things|of whom / of which can replace whose|the noun after whose is not omitted|who and whose must not be confused
The boy whose father is a doctor is my friend.
column3: 那个父亲是医生的男孩是我的朋友。

# title: The boy _____ father is a doctor is my friend.
column4: 考查whose expresses belonging, modifying people or things。此处应为 whose。句意:那个父亲是医生的男孩是我的朋友。
